verdict.rationale: Sentry's own web API is documented to 'manage and export data', and an official OpenAPI schema covers the full /api/0/ surface, so programmatic export exists. Nothing shows a complete, one-shot export of all account data in documented open formats for leaving the service. The documented relocation tooling only moves self-hosted instances into SaaS, which is the opposite direction, and Splunk data forwarding is an integration rather than an exit export. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export or exit/offboarding path, an explicit open-format guarantee covering all data types, and hands-on corroboration of a complete data exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
publishes the dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for the "Sentry Public API"
